arxiv-1806-04779.title: Convolutional Neural Networks for Aircraft Noise Monitoring
arxiv-1806-04779.creator: Nicholas Heller, Derek Anderson, Matt Baker, Brad Juffer, Nikolaos Papanikolopoulos
arxiv-1806-04779.description: Abstract Air travel is one of the fastest growing modes of transportation, however, the effects of aircraft noise on populations surrounding airports is hindering its growth. In an effort to study and ultimately mitigate the impact that this noise has, many airports continuously monitor the aircraft noise in their surrounding communities.

arxiv-1909-00412.title: You Shall Know a User by the Company It Keeps: Dynamic Representations for Social Media Users in NLP
arxiv-1909-00412.creator: Marco Del Tredici, Diego Marcheggiani, Sabine Schulte im Walde, Raquel Fernández
arxiv-1909-00412.description: Abstract Information about individuals can help to better understand what they say, particularly in social media where texts are short. Current approaches to modelling social media users pay attention to their social connections, but exploit this information in a static way, treating all connections uniformly.

arxiv-2012-15234.title: Artificial Intelligence Development Races in Heterogeneous Settings
arxiv-2012-15234.creator: Theodor Cimpeanu, Francisco C. Santos, Luís Moniz Pereira, Tom Lenaerts, The Anh Han

arxiv-2307-04307.title: Weyl Semimetallic State in the Rashba-Hubbard Model
arxiv-2307-04307.creator: Katsunori Kubo
arxiv-2307-04307.description: Abstract We investigate the Hubbard model with the Rashba spin-orbit coupling on a square lattice. The Rashba spin-orbit coupling generates two-dimensional Weyl points in the band dispersion. In a system with edges along [11] direction, zero-energy edge states appear, while no edge state exists for a system with edges along an axis direction.

arxiv-2309-03007.title: Prospects for combined analyses of hadronic emission from γ \gamma -ray sources in the Milky Way with CTA and KM3NeT Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2309-03007.creator: T. Unbehaun ECAP,emailtim, L. Mohrmann MPIK,emaillars, S. Funk ECAP (authors of the CTA Consortium) and S. Aiello a, A. Albert b,be, S. Alves Garre c, Z. Aly d, A. Ambrosone f,e, F. Ameli g, M. Andre h, E. Androutsou i, M. Anghinolfi j, M. Anguita k, L. Aphecetche l, M. Ardid m, S. Ardid m, H. Atman
arxiv-2309-03007.description: Abstract The Cherenkov Telescope Array and the KM3NeT neutrino telescopes are major upcoming facilities in the fields of γ \gamma -ray and neutrino astronomy, respectively. Possible simultaneous production of γ \gamma rays and neutrinos in astrophysical accelerators of cosmic-ray nuclei motivates a combination of their data.

arxiv-2409-18295.title: Enhancing Lossy Compression Through Cross-Field Information for Scientific Applications
arxiv-2409-18295.creator: Youyuan Liu, Wenqi Jia, Taolue Yang, Miao Yin, Sian Jin
arxiv-2409-18295.description: Abstract Lossy compression is one of the most effective methods for reducing the size of scientific data containing multiple data fields. It reduces information density through prediction or transformation techniques to compress the data. Previous approaches use local information from a single target field when predicting target data points, limiting their potential to achieve higher compression ratios.

arxiv-2412-00526.title: Human Action CLIPs: Detecting AI-Generated Human Motion
arxiv-2412-00526.creator: Matyas Bohacek, Hany Farid
arxiv-2412-00526.description: Abstract AI-generated video generation continues its journey through the uncanny valley to produce content that is increasingly perceptually indistinguishable from reality. To better protect individuals, organizations, and societies from its malicious applications, we describe an effective and robust technique for distinguishing real from AI-generated human motion using multi-modal semantic embeddings.

arxiv-2412-08452.title: Pion and kaon pair production in double gap events in ALICE Run 3 Thanks: Presented at “Diffraction and Low- x x 2024”, Trabia (Palermo, Italy), September 8-14, 2024.
arxiv-2412-08452.creator: Rainer Schicker, for the ALICE Collaboration
arxiv-2412-08452.description: Abstract The ALICE detector at the LHC has undergone a major upgrade in the long shutdown 2019-2021 to be able to take data at much-increased rates in Runs 3 and 4. The upgrades of the detector systems used for analysing double gap events are described, and the improvement in data taking capability for such double gap events is presented.

arxiv-2412-16727.title: Fundamental thresholds for computational and erasure errors via the coherent information
arxiv-2412-16727.creator: Luis Colmenarez, Seyong Kim, Markus Müller
arxiv-2412-16727.description: Abstract Quantum error correcting (QEC) codes protect quantum information against environmental noise. Computational errors caused by the environment change the quantum state within the qubit subspace, whereas quantum erasures correspond to the loss of qubits at known positions. Correcting either type of error involves different correction mechanisms, which makes studying the interplay between erasure and computational errors particularly challenging.

arxiv-2508-01271.title: Wiener chaos expansion for stochastic Maxwell equations driven by Wiener process
arxiv-2508-01271.creator: Lihai Ji, Kuan Xue and Liying Zhang Institute of Applied Physics and Computational Mathematics, Beijing 100094, China. Shanghai Zhangjiang Institute of Mathematics, Shanghai 201203, China. School of Mathematical Science, China University of Mining and Technology (Beijing),Beijing 100083, China.
arxiv-2508-01271.description: Abstract A novel and efficient algorithm based on the Wiener chaos expansion is proposed for the stochastic Maxwell equations driven by Wiener process. The proposed algorithm can reduce the original stochastic system to the deterministic case and separate the randomness in the computation.

arxiv-2509-03690.title: Low-Cost Open-Source Ambidextrous Robotic Hand with 23 Direct-Drive servos for American Sign Language Alphabet
arxiv-2509-03690.creator: Kelvin Gonzalez Amador
arxiv-2509-03690.description: Abstract Accessible communication through sign language is vital for deaf communities, yet robotic solutions are often costly and limited. This study presents VulcanV3, a low-cost, open-source, 3D-printed ambidextrous robotic hand capable of reproducing the full American Sign Language (ASL) alphabet (52 signs for right- and left-hand configurations).

arxiv-2509-07737.title: Anatomy of parameter-estimation biases in overlapping gravitational-wave signals: detector network
arxiv-2509-07737.creator: Ziming Wang, Dicong Liang, Lijing Shao
arxiv-2509-07737.description: Abstract With the significantly improved sensitivity and a wider frequency band, the next-generation gravitational-wave (GW) detectors are anticipated to detect ∼ 10 5 \sim 10^{5} GW signals per year with durations from hours to days, leading to inevitable signal overlaps in the data stream.

arxiv-2601-14437.title: Agentic AI Meets Edge Computing in Autonomous UAV Swarms
arxiv-2601-14437.creator: Thuan Minh Nguyen, Vu Tuan Truong, Long Bao Le
arxiv-2601-14437.description: Abstract The integration of agentic AI, powered by large language models (LLMs) with autonomous reasoning, planning, and execution, into unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms opens new operational possibilities and brings the vision of the Internet of Drones closer to reality.

plaw-114-87-2015.description: Public Law 114-87 (2015): Surface Transportation Extension Act of 2015, Part II

pmc-10602602.title: The apiosyltransferase celery UGT94AX1 catalyzes the biosynthesis of the flavone glycoside apiin
pmc-10602602.creator: Maho Yamashita, Tae Fujimori, Song An, Sho Iguchi, Yuto Takenaka, Hiroyuki Kajiura, Takuya Yoshizawa, Hiroyoshi Matsumura, Masaru Kobayashi, Eiichiro Ono, Takeshi Ishimizu
pmc-10602602.description: Apiose is a unique branched-chain pentose found in plant glycosides and a key component of the cell wall polysaccharide pectin and other specialized metabolites. More than 1,200 plant-specialized metabolites contain apiose residues, represented by apiin, a distinctive flavone glycoside found in celery (Apium graveolens) and parsley (Petroselinum crispum) in the family Apiaceae.

pmc-10720296.title: Green Synthesis of Withania coagulans Extract-Mediated Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles as Photocatalysts and Biological Agents
pmc-10720296.creator: Saima Maher, Bakht Zamina, Musarat Riaz, Sana Riaz, Noreen Khalid, Muhammad Imran, Shagufta Fahmid, Hina Ishtiaq, Shafia Parveen
pmc-10720296.description: Recently, biosynthesized nanoparticles (NPs) have played a vital role as an alternative to physical and chemical methods. Here, a distinctive bioinspired synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) has been introduced using leaf extracts of Withania coagulans as the reducing agent by using distilled water and methanol.

pmc-10737821.title: GENERATING OLDER ACTIVE LIVES DIGITALLY (GOALD) THROUGH SPORT-BASED REMINISCENCE
pmc-10737821.creator: Richard Haynes, John Ritchie, Simone Tomaz
pmc-10737821.description: How do digitally-delivered meaningful activities, such as sport-based reminiscence, influence older people’s health and well-being and intergenerational relationships? Developing and strengthening older people’s ’connectivities’ through their links with community, resources and meaningful activities is a key aspect of supporting healthy ageing and reducing health inequalities in later life.

pmc-11430370.title: Antidiabetic and Antihyperlipidemic Activities and Molecular Mechanisms of Phyllanthus emblica L. Extract in Mice on a High-Fat Diet
pmc-11430370.creator: Hsing-Yi Lin, Cheng-Hsiu Lin, Yueh-Hsiung Kuo, Chun-Ching Shih
pmc-11430370.description: We planned to explore the protective activities of extract of Phyllanthus emblica L. (EPE) on insulin resistance and metabolic disorders including hyperlipidemia, visceral obesity, and renal dysfunction in high-fat diet (HFD)-progressed T2DM mice. Mice treatments included 7 weeks of HFD induction followed by EPE, fenofibrate (Feno), or metformin (Metf) treatment daily for another 4-week HFD in HFD-fed mice.

pmc-11461574.title: Postoperative recovery in peroral versus intravenous antibiotic treatment following laparoscopic appendectomy for complicated appendicitis: a substudy of a cluster randomized cluster crossover non-inferiority study
pmc-11461574.creator: Ahmed Abdirahman Mohamud, Walid Zeyghami, Jakob Kleif, Ismail Gögenur
pmc-11461574.description: BackgroundAcute appendicitis is the most common cause of abdominal pain requiring surgery, usually managed with laparoscopic appendectomy. In Denmark, the standard postoperative treatment for complicated cases involves intravenous antibiotics. This study compares peroral versus intravenous antibiotics in the context of fast-track surgery and Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols.

pmc-11647411.title: Characteristics of bovine muscle satellite cell from different breeds for efficient production of cultured meat
pmc-11647411.creator: Yun-a Kim, Sehyuk Oh, Gyutae Park, Sanghun Park, Yunhwan Park, Hyunsoo Choi, Minjung Kim, Jungseok Choi
pmc-11647411.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The purpose of this study was comparing in vitro performances of three breeds of donor satellite cells for cultured meat and selecting the optimal donor and providing insight into the selection of donors for cultured meat production. Cattle muscle satellite cells were isolated from the muscle tissue of Hanwoo, Holstein, and Jeju black cattle, and then sorted by fluorescence activated cell sorting (FACS). Regarding proliferation of satellite cells, all three breeds showed similar trends.

pmc-11671937.title: Are we making progress in curing advanced cervical cancer—again?
pmc-11671937.creator: Jacob Christian Lindegaard, Primoz Petric, Li-Tee Tan, Peter Hoskin, Maximilian P Schmid, Ina Jürgenliemk-Schulz, Umesh Mahantshetty, Christian Kirisits, Richard Pötter, Linda Gough
pmc-11671937.description: Major improvements in radiotherapy over the past two decades in the definitive treatment of locally advanced cervical cancer have significantly improved loco-regional control and survival, whereas little progress has been made with chemotherapy since the implementation of concomitant cisplatin 25 years ago.

pmc-12466341.title: Traumatic Oral Lesions in Loggerhead Sea Turtles (Caretta caretta) Linked to Polychaete (Laetmonice cf. hystrix) Ingestion: A Case Report from the Northern Adriatic Sea
pmc-12466341.creator: Stefano Pesaro, Lucia Biagini, Danilo De Bellis, Luca Dorigo, Alice Baggio, Isabella Perlin, Giacomo Rossi, Simone Angelucci, Cristina Esmeralda Di Francesco, Camilla Smoglica, Jorge Ramón López-Olvera
pmc-12466341.description: Simple SummaryThis case report describes a rare clinical finding of traumatic oral lesions in a juvenile loggerhead sea turtle (Caretta caretta) rescued from the Northern Adriatic Sea. The turtle exhibited severe injuries in the oral cavity, upper gastrointestinal tract, and larynx, caused by the accidental ingestion of a tropical benthic polychaete, Laetmonice cf. hystrix.

pmc-12538482.title: Tension pneumothorax and pneumoperitoneum following shoulder arthroscopy in a single-lung patient: A case report
pmc-12538482.creator: Byunghyuk Yu, Inhwan Yeo, Changho Kim, Yeonjoo Cho, Jae Yeong Yang, Hyo-Won Chang
pmc-12538482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionShoulder arthroscopy is generally considered a low-risk procedure; however, complications related to patient positioning, positive-pressure ventilation, and general anesthesia may arise, particularly in high-risk patients.Case presentationWe report the case of a 57-year-old man with a history of left pneumonectomy for pulmonary abscess and Swyer–James syndrome who developed a life-threatening complication during arthroscopic rotator cuff repair performed under general anesthesia in the left lateral decubitus position. Intraoperatively, the patient developed cardiac arrest with pulseless ventricular tachycardia (VT).

pmc-13368945.title: Facile synthesis of Zn-Mn bimetallic MOF for adsorptive removal of methyl paraben from aqueous solution
pmc-13368945.creator: Anusha D Shetty, Athira Balachandran Nair, Harshini Dasari, Nethaji Sundarabal
pmc-13368945.description: A zinc-manganese bimetallic metal-organic framework (Zn-Mn MOF) was synthesised using room temperature, and its adsorption performance was evaluated against methyl paraben (MePr), an emerging endocrine-disrupting compound. The adsorbent exhibited high removal efficiencies for MePr, corresponding to the synergistic effect of Zn and Mn, and its high specific surface area (SSA) of 1657.2 m2/g.

pmc-13658390.title: In-source freezing of Trifolium repens leaf tissue to increase spatial resolution and quench stress responses during IR-MALDESI mass spectrometry imaging
pmc-13658390.creator: Quinn Mills, David C. Muddiman
pmc-13658390.description: Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) is a robust analytical tool for resolving the spatial localization of diverse metabolites in a tissue sample simultaneously. Infrared matrix-assisted laser desorption electrospray ionization (IR-MALDESI) is particularly advantageous for analyzing leaf tissue, since it bypasses the cuticle and uses endogenous water in the sample as a matrix, avoiding delocalization and reducing costs associated with sample preparation.
